scope_user: Both backbones, all fitted artifacts and planning curves use WorldSense only; rerun both models.
calibration_input: Video-text only, common resized uint8 frames at max384^2 pixels, source-clock positions. The same64source videos and WorldSense gold-option questions on both backbones. No benchmark questions or answers enter fitting.
calibration_views: Deterministic source-hash ordering cycles through64/128/256frames; groups denote input geometry, not actual source duration. One view per source, same pixels for both models.
GSRQ: Retain original family FP16 fitting and FP8 export, independently fitted per layer/head; common source vectors/gradient-norm weights with shared RVQ.
CQ: Same frozen C/c operating formats, fit Fisher-weighted centroids on WorldSense gold-option gradients; do not select formats or seeds on test accuracy.
NOVA: Native Q/K/output moments and bounded real keys from the64WorldSense videos; original group8 format and byte accounting.
loss_tables: All conditional and depth-rate curves measured afresh for each model and seed on WorldSense pre-question prefixes; no Video-MME or TempCompass videos used.
unchanged_controls: Reuse the previously audited complete three-run predictions for BF16 and deterministic non-fitted selectors; their model weights, inputs, seeds and algorithms are unchanged. Explicit source hashes retained. Run native equality gates before reuse.
paper: Update all results that depend on the changed codec; preserve canonical PDF until new experiments and layout checks finish.12science pages,AI/references13,noappendix.
public_release: Source/seed recipes/small deployable codecs only; no specific experimental results.
continuity: No chat-turn cron/loop tool exists. Keep working in active turn; resumable local workers/resource monitor do not constitute agent-turn scheduling.
hypothesis: Unified external calibration improves protocol comparability; no direction or size of accuracy change is presumed.
